test_title: PYST 25: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is a good way to keep your files organized on a computer?

options.text: Use separate folders for different types of files
Store everything in a single folder

solution:
The correct answer is __**Use separate folders for different types of files**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Organizing files into separate folders based on types (e.g., documents, images, videos) ensures easier navigation and retrieval of data.
 
• Using specific folders reduces clutter and enhances efficiency in locating files.
 
• It helps in categorizing and managing large volumes of data systematically.
 
• Folders can be further divided into subfolders for more detailed organization, such as year, project, or department-specific files.
 
• Proper file organization reduces redundancy and the likelihood of losing important data.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **File Hierarchy:** A tree-like structure of folders and subfolders helps in organizing data systematically.
 
• **Naming Conventions:** Use meaningful and consistent file and folder names to identify content easily (e.g., "Project_Report_2023").
 
• **File Backup:** Regularly back up your organized folders to cloud storage or external drives to prevent data loss.
 
• **Search Functionality:** Well-organized folders make it easier to utilize search tools to locate files quickly.
 
• **File Tags:** Some systems allow tagging files with keywords, which can complement folder organization for quicker access.
